subsection.name: Description
subsection.div:
Reports the modified cyclomatic complexity of every method, constructor, static initializer and instance initializer. It is a measure of the number of independent paths through the source and therefore of the number of required tests, it is not about quality of code. See
initializer blocks for details on initializers.
subsection.p: Counting starts at 0 and each decision point adds 1. Decision points:

ul.li: if, else, while, do, for, ?:, catch and switch statements. An else if counts once, and a whole switch block counts as a single decision point regardless of the cases, guards or nested statements it contains.
Sequences of the same logical operator && or || in the body of target. Each uninterrupted sequence counts once regardless of its length.
Recursive calls, that is calls to a method with the same name as the enclosing method.

subsection.p: The complexity is reported for every target together with its name. Initializer blocks are reported as ClassName.INSTANCE_INIT and ClassName.STATIC_INIT.

tr.td: Control whether to treat the whole switch block as a single decision point.

subset of tokens
LITERAL_WHILE , LITERAL_DO , LITERAL_FOR , LITERAL_IF , LITERAL_ELSE , LITERAL_SWITCH , LITERAL_CASE , LITERAL_DEFAULT , LITERAL_CATCH , QUESTION , LAND , LOR , LITERAL_WHEN , METHOD_CALL .

subsection.name: Examples
subsection.p: To configure the check with a threshold of 4 and check only for while and do-while loops:

pre.code: <module name="Checker"> <module name="TreeWalker"> <module name="CyclomaticComplexity"> <property name="max" value="4"/> <property name="tokens" value="LITERAL_WHILE, LITERAL_DO"/> </module> </module> </module>
